messages:
tara-pm: Quick sync — we need a concise plan for private-deploy priorities: airgap-friendly installer, a customer-managed egress "fastpath", and a short upgrade playbook customers can hand to NetOps. Keep it runnable.

noah-eng: Suggest we split into M1: `airgap-bundle` alpha, M2: `egress-fastpath` experimental, M3: `upgrade-playbook` + GA gating. Airgap should be a signed tarball + local verifier.

jamie-field: Field signals: 3 enterprise prospects will stall without IP preservation across upgrades. One is willing to run validation in a staging window. They also want a one-page preflight checklist.

omar-se: Minimal operator config proposal (sketch):
```
egress_fastpath:
  enabled: true
  type: customer_managed
  cidrs: ["203.0.113.64/28"]
  preserve_on_upgrade: true
  advisory_mode: false  # if true, warn but don't block
```
If `preserve_on_upgrade` is true, orchestrator must prefer in-place patches and surface `upgrade_blocker` reasons when it cannot comply.

noah-eng: Engineering notes: preserving external mapping complicates kernel/host upgrades. We'll add an `advisory_mode` first so customers can see potential drift without blocking. Full preserve will require extra e2e and a dry-run simulator.

tara-pm: Risk/contract question: lena, does offering "preserve" require changes to our network appendix?

lena-legal: Yes — any explicit preservation promise needs a narrowly-defined contract clause and enumerated exceptions (cloud provider maintenance, required host kernel changes, customer-side NAT reconfiguration). I can draft a stub once eng defines the exact abort codes and the advisory vs guaranteed behavior.

jamie-field: Pilot customer will accept advisory_mode first, then a canary with preserve_on_upgrade. They want a preflight: snapshot egress mappings, run dry-run, single-node canary, then monitored rollout.

noah-eng: Proposed timeline: sprint+1 -> airgap-bundle alpha (signed bundle + local verifier + telemetry off), sprint+2 -> advisory-mode dry-run for egress-fastpath + simulator CLI, sprint+3 -> preserve_on_upgrade beta with pilot. Acceptance criteria:
- airgap alpha: offline install with bundled artifacts, signature verification, telemetry disabled-by-default;
- advisory dry-run: `rwin upgrade --egress-fastpath --dry-run` that returns `simulated_ip_drift_count` and `upgrade_blocker_reasons`;
- beta preserve: in-place upgrade test that keeps external mapping for canary cluster in pilot infra.

omar-se: Will implement the dry-run first. CLI output will include structured lines and a short human summary. We'll emit metrics: `upgrade_success_rate`, `ip_preservation_failures`, `mean_outage_seconds`.

lena-legal: I'll prepare appendix language that includes an explicit definition of "ip preservation", a list of exceptions, and a note that beta features are non-contractual until GA. Engineering: share the error codes and the dry-run output sample.

deploy-bot: tickets created: PD-14011 (airgap-bundle-alpha), PD-14012 (egress-fastpath-dry-run), PD-14013 (upgrade-playbook-and-checklist).

noah-eng: Dev owner split: I'll take airgap packaging + verifier. Omar will take fastpath dry-run + simulator. Add audit-only install events so we don't ship customer PII.

tara-pm: OK decisions: prioritize airgap alpha sprint+1, dry-run advisory sprint+2, preserve beta sprint+3 contingent on pilot and legal appendix. Action owners: noah -> PD-14011, omar -> PD-14012, jamie -> pilot ops, lena -> contract appendix. I'll update the roadmap and send a short PRD to the product folder with timelines and acceptance criteria. :thumbsup:

jamie-field: I'll confirm pilot timeslot today and share the preflight checklist.

noah-eng: One engineering note: keep the fastpath opt-in per-cluster to limit blast radius. We'll add a big installer warning when profile selected.

tara-pm: Great, closing here. Small follow-up: include the three canary metrics in each ticket.
